dish: Handmade pasta and tiramisu
address: Goldhill Plaza, Thomson Road (Novena), Singapore (unit + postal to confirm at geocode)
w: An underrated Italian dining room in Goldhill Plaza by Novena — pricey, but the pasta plates earn it and the tiramisu is the one people come back for; a constant on Novena lists from Lady Iron Chef (2018) to Seth Lui and Honeycombers.

dish: Roast chicken rice, char siew and roast pork belly
n: Chye Kee Goldhill Roasted Chicken Rice
address: Goldhill Shopping Centre, Thomson Road (Novena), Singapore (unit + postal to confirm at geocode)
w: The Goldhill Centre roast-meat counter whose window of lacquered roast chicken, char siew, crackling pork belly and duck has been a Novena lunch fixture for years — on both Lady Iron Chef's Novena guide and Seth Lui's Novena & Thomson must-tries.

dish: Minced meat noodles (bak chor mee) tossed in XO sauce
address: #01-10 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: Bak chor mee given a luxe twist with XO sauce — one of the Newton stalls that the local food press point to beyond the tourist seafood row (Daniel Food Diary's 12 Newton stalls; City Nomads' 8-stall guide).

dish: Hot and cold Chinese desserts
n: 88 San Ren Cold and Hot Dessert
address: Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495 (unit to confirm)
w: The dessert stop to end a Newton supper — a broad board of hot and cold Chinese sweets — listed by both Eatbook and Daniel Food Diary in their Newton Food Centre guides.

dish: Charcoal-barbecued seafood
address: #01-31 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: One of Newton's evening barbecue-seafood stalls, picked out by both Seth Lui's 16-best (Oct 2024 update) and Eatbook's 15-best Newton guides.

dish: Contemporary European tasting menus
n: Alma by Juan Amador (Goodwood Park Hotel)
address: Goodwood Park Hotel, 22 Scotts Road, Singapore 228221
w: The one-MICHELIN-Star contemporary European dining room inside the Goodwood Park Hotel — Juan Amador's restaurant, and the starred table of the Newton/Scotts Road edge.

dish: Steaks and roasts carved from the meat trolley
address: Goodwood Park Hotel, 22 Scotts Road, Singapore 228221
w: The Goodwood Park's old-school grill room, a MICHELIN Selected address famous for its meat trolley carved at the table.

dish: Elevated Taiwanese tasting menu (cai poh butter)
address: 27 Scotts Road, Singapore 228222
w: Contemporary Taiwanese cooking in a black-and-white colonial house on Scotts Road — MICHELIN Selected, and featured by the Guide for its signature cai poh butter; Time Out calls it a hidden gem.

dish: Set menus — house-made tagliatelle with shaved white truffle
address: 29 Scotts Road, Singapore 228224
w: A one-MICHELIN-Star Italian dining room in a Scotts Road colonial house, chef Denis Lucchi's set menus led by house-made tagliatelle under shaved white truffle; also on Honeycombers' Newton guide.

dish: Kueh pie tee, ayam buah keluak, assam laksa
address: 35 Scotts Road, Singapore 228227
w: A Peranakan restaurant in a white colonial house on Scotts Road — signature kueh pie tee, organic ayam buah keluak, assam laksa — one of only four Peranakan restaurants in the MICHELIN Bib Gourmand 2023 (Eatbook); on Honeycombers' Newton guide.

dish: Fried chicken and Belgian waffles
address: Balmoral Plaza, 271 Bukit Timah Road, Singapore
w: A family-run retro American fast-food diner serving for more than three decades — fried chicken with Belgian waffles, burgers — that Lady Iron Chef, Seth Lui and Eatbook all describe as a time-travel back to the '80s; listed in Honeycombers' Newton guide.

dish: Old-school prawn mee with wild-caught prawns, pork slices and crispy lard
address: Hawkers' Street food court, Square 2, 10 Sinaran Drive, Singapore (unit to confirm)
w: The Novena branch (opened Sep 2025) of the Michelin-recognised 545 Whampoa prawn mee: wild-caught prawns, pork slices and crispy lard in a deep prawn broth — headline stall of Square 2's new Hawkers' Street food court (Seth Lui; Eatbook).

dish: Sliced fish soup, fried fish soup and mixed fish soup
n: Tai Seng Fish Soup (Hawkers' Street Novena)
address: Hawkers' Street food court, Square 2, 10 Sinaran Drive, Singapore (unit to confirm)
w: Fish soup in sliced, fried and mixed versions (from $6.30) at Novena's Hawkers' Street food court, one of the 'Michelin-approved' names Eatbook and Seth Lui flagged at its Sep 2025 opening.

dish: Nasi padang — halal Malay rice with lauk
address: #01-83 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: One of Newton's most popular Muslim stalls: homely halal Malay nasi padang in generous servings, 6am-3pm daily — reviewed by Miss Tam Chiak and listed in Eatbook's 15 best Newton stalls (Seth Lui has covered it too).

dish: North Indian curries, tandoori and naan (113-dish menu)
address: Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495 (unit to confirm: guides print #01-44 and #01-57)
w: A North Indian stall with a 113-dish menu, at Newton for years — in both Seth Lui's 16 best (Oct 2024) and Eatbook's 15 best Newton stalls.

dish: Charcoal satay (chicken, mutton, pork, prawn), BBQ wings and otah
address: #01-33 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: Satay since 1998: juicy charcoal-grilled chicken, mutton and pork sticks dunked in chunky peanut sauce, plus prawn satay, BBQ wings and otah — evenings from 4pm; on Eatbook's 15 best Newton stalls and Daniel Food Diary's 12 Newton stalls.

dish: BBQ seafood — sambal stingray and grilled sea treasures
address: #01-11 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: A Newton barbecue-seafood stall since 1983, now run by the third generation — sambal stingray and grilled seafood (Honeycombers' Newton guide; Daniel Food Diary's Newton stalls).

dish: Specialty coffee and all-day breakfast
address: 173 Thomson Road, Goldhill Plaza, Singapore (unit to confirm)
w: A quiet specialty-coffee stop for Novena office workers and students, with all-day breakfast — on Lady Iron Chef's Novena/Goldhill guides and Seth Lui's Novena & Thomson must-tries.

dish: Wallet-friendly Mexican plates
address: Novena Regency, Novena, Singapore (unit to confirm at geocode)
w: A quiet Mexican eatery tucked inside the Novena Regency condominium since 2018, known mostly by word of mouth for modestly priced, unpretentious Mexican food (Seth Lui); SilverKris counts it among Novena's neighbourhood favourites.

dish: Pan-Indian menu — Keralan-spiced lamb shank, pomegranate tandoori prawns, Lucknavi gilawat kebabs
address: 33 Scotts Road, Singapore 228226
w: Chef Manjunath Mural's pan-Indian dining room in a black-and-white Scotts Road bungalow — Keralan-spiced lamb shank, tandoori prawns in pomegranate marinade, Lucknavi gilawat kebabs. Time Out notes its MICHELIN Star; it has its own MICHELIN Guide entry.

dish: Hainanese curry rice with pork chop or prawn roll
n: Hill Street Hainanese Curry Rice (Hawkers' Street Novena)
address: Hawkers' Street food court, Square 2, 10 Sinaran Drive, Singapore (unit to confirm)
w: Hainanese curry rice — pork chop or prawn roll over rice drowned in curry gravies ($6.30) — one of the hawker names Seth Lui and Eatbook flagged at Square 2's Hawkers' Street food court opening (Sep 2025).

dish: Poached and roasted Hainanese chicken rice
address: Thomson Road (opposite Novena Church), Novena, Singapore (unit to confirm at geocode)
w: A young-hawkerpreneur chicken-rice shop on Thomson Road facing Novena Church: moist, tender poached and roasted chicken over rice that isn't oily — praised by Dr Leslie Tay (ieatishootipost: 'young, innovative next-generation hawkers') and Seth Lui.

dish: Steamed sea bass and home-style Northern Thai curries, salads and rice dishes
address: Royal Square at Novena, 103 Irrawaddy Road, #02-07, Singapore
w: A Bangkok family's first overseas outpost (they run seven restaurants at home): home-style Thai cooking with many Northern Thai recipes, steamed sea bass and most dishes under $10 — reviewed by Seth Lui and Daniel Food Diary, and on Lady Iron Chef's Novena guide.

dish: Banelé — banana bread × brownie × canelé hybrid
address: Chancery Court, Chancery Lane (near Newton), Singapore (unit to confirm at geocode)
w: The online bakery's first shop near Newton MRT, selling its namesake banelé — a banana-bread, brownie and canelé hybrid with a chocolatey centre and caramelised crust (Daniel Food Diary's new cafés, May 2024; Women's Weekly's new Balestier & Novena openings).
